description: This file defines the interface 'ConnectionLifecycle' which manages the life cycle of a connection to a Hono service, including establishing connections, disconnecting, and managing connection listeners.

classes.name: ConnectionLifecycle
classes.description: A Java interface providing methods to manage the connection lifecycle to a Hono service, including connect, disconnect, and listener management.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes the underlying AMQP connection to the service, returning a Future that completes when the connection is established.

methods.name: addDisconnectListener
methods.description: Adds a listener that will be notified when the connection is unexpectedly lost.

methods.name: addReconnectListener
methods.description: Adds a listener that will be notified when the connection has been re-established after being lost.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the connection is currently established, returning a Future that completes successfully if connected.

methods.name: isConnected (default method)
methods.description: Returns the connection status, defaulting to the result of 'isConnected()'.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from the service without auto-retrying.

methods.name: disconnect (with handler)
methods.description: Disconnects from the service and notifies the result via the provided handler.
